audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer describes abilities Aurelion Sol does not have. It names his Q 'Q Starfire' (twice) and his ultimate 'Voice of Light' (twice), and builds the entire late-game plan around 'Voice of Light's continuous damage'. Neither name exists in this kit — Voice of Light is not even an Aurelion Sol ability.
audit.why: Owner kit: Q Breath of Light (750 channelled beam, 3s), W Astral Flight (1500, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16), E the black hole (750, 12s, percent-health execute), R Falling Star / The Skies Descend (1250, 120/110/100). Riot's text for R is a crashing star that stuns, not a continuous beam.
audit.corrected: Every 'Starfire' replaced with Breath of Light and every 'Voice of Light' with The Skies Descend, and the late-game plan restated around what the ultimate actually does: drag and stun a grouped team from 1250 while the stardust-fed beam burns them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one piece of counterplay that decides this lane was never stated: Light Binding hits up to two units and stops, so a minion body blocks it outright. The page only says 'minion-block it' inside a template line, never why it works or that the root is what cancels your channel.
audit.why: Enemy Q: 'Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units', range 1175, cooldown 10 flat at every rank, projectile and hardCC flags. Owner Q carries the channel flag, so that root ends Breath of Light. Also unstated: her passive Illumination marks you on any spell and her AUTO detonates it, which is why greedy beam ticks in her auto range cost double.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5], tradeBad, tradeGood and early: keep a minion on her Q line, and the 10 seconds after a spent Light Binding is your window.
sources: brief enemyKit Q and passive text

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: 'level chart contradicts data: Aurelion Sol wins 53.18% but the chart gives Lux 6/7 stages vs 1'. On top of that, all three of full phases[4/5/6].side read 'Skill' against content win[] of Lux/Lux/Aurelion Sol — three rows rendering two answers. And content win[5]='Lux' contradicts its OWN whys[5], which says 'Your ... spike finally lets sustained burst outpace her poke'.
audit.why: The first-item row is the one that is genuinely wrong rather than merely stale, and the page itself says so: whys[5] and phases[5].why both describe the OWNER taking over at first item, while the side says Lux. Grounded in the kits, that is the right read — Lux has no dash anywhere in her kit, and from first item the black-hole execute clears waves from 750 while a 1250-range stun catches a champion who cannot leave. Level 6 stays hers: Final Spark is 60s at rank 1 against Falling Star's 120s.
audit.corrected: Proposed as one atomic group with matched layer pairs: phases[4].side -> Lux (with phases[4].why rewritten in the same proposal to justify it), phases[5].side -> Aurelion Sol AND content win[5] -> Aurelion Sol together, phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol. The resulting chart is 5 Lux / 2 Aurelion Sol, which no longer argues with a 53.18% win rate and no longer argues with its own whys.

audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists lux as female; the owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun refers to Lux.
audit.corrected: All corrected to she/her, and the framing fixed at the same time — Lux is a poke champion, not a burst assassin, so 'his burst window is real' was wrong on two counts.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Light Binding. Light Binding is 10 seconds flat at every rank.
audit.why: Real numbers: Light Binding 10 flat at 1175, Lucent Singularity 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 at 1100, Prismatic Barrier 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Final Spark 60/50/40 at 3340, owner Falling Star 120/110/100.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now lists them, dosFull[2].d says 10 seconds, and the 60s-versus-120s ultimate gap is stated in phases[4].why and spikes[1].text — that gap is the actual reason level 6 belongs to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers prescribe different builds. The full layer says Rod of Ages rush or Seraph's, then Archangel's, Liandry's, Rabadon's; the content layer builds its whole first-item spike around 'Liandry's/Nashor's' and 'Liandry's/Stormsurge'.

audit.corrected: Content-layer item references aligned to the full layer's Rod of Ages / Seraph's path, which is the one the report section states.

notes: This matchup's content layer was written for a different champion in places: it calls Aurelion Sol's Q 'Q Starfire' twice and his ultimate 'Voice of Light' twice, including building the entire late-game plan on 'Voice of Light's continuous damage'. Voice of Light is not an Aurelion Sol ability at all. Together with the 'Voidlink (E)' sightings in the katarina and leblanc matchups, this champion's content file looks to have inherited text from at least one other kit — worth a grep for Starfire, Voidlink and Voice of Light across all aurelionsol matchups, not just mine. LEVEL CHART, and please read this one: the packet itself flags 'chart contradicts data: Aurelion Sol wins 53.18% but the chart gives Lux 6/7 stages'. I did not just move rows to suit the win rate — content win[5] was contradicting its OWN whys[5], which says the owner's first item finally outpaces her poke, and phases[5].why says the same. I moved the first-item row to Aurelion Sol in BOTH layers as a matched pair, moved the 2+ items row to Aurelion Sol (its why already said so), and left level 6 with Lux, rewriting phases[4].why to justify it on the real numbers: Final Spark is 60s at rank 1 against Falling Star's 120s. Confidence on that row group is Medium rather than High — it is the one judgement call in this slice, and if you would rather the chart stay as shipped, revert those four edits together, not individually. Separately: the two layers disagree on itemization (full says Rod of Ages/Seraph's; content built its spikes on Liandry's/Nashor's/Stormsurge). I aligned content to the full layer's stated build, but if Liandry's-first is actually the intended path for this champion, the report[8] Itemization text is what needs changing instead.
